content: Manga Sarona Opuana Isa Al Masi
Siimo manga opuana Isa Al Masi, siwuluna Daud, siwuluna Ibrahim. Minaaka i Ibrahim sakawana i Daud, manga sarona opuana Isa sumai mboomo sii:
Ibrahim akoanaakamo Ishak, Ishak akoanaakamo Yakub, Yakub akoanaakamo Yuda tee manga witinaina,
Yuda akoanaakamo Peres tee Zerah. Inana Peres tee Zerah isarongiaka Tamar. Peres akoanaakamo Hezron, Hezron akoanaakamo Ram,
Ram akoanaakamo Aminadab, Aminadab akoanaakamo Nahason, Nahason akoanaakamo Salmon,
Salmon akoanaakamo Boas. Inana Boas isarongiaka Rahab. Boas akoanaakamo Obed. Inana Obed isarongiaka Rut. Obed akoanaakamo Isai,
Isai akoanaakamo Raja Daud, Raja Daud akoanaakamo Sulaiman minaaka i iaiarona Uria;
Sulaiman akoanaakamo Rehabeam, Rehabeam akoanaakamo Abia, Abia akoanaakamo Asa,
Asa akoanaakamo Yosafat, Yosafat akoanaakamo Yoram, Yoram akoanaakamo Uzia,
Uzia akoanaakamo Yotam, Yotam akoanaakamo Ahas, Ahas akoanaakamo Hizkia.
Hizkia akoanaakamo Manasye, Manasye akoanaakamo Amon, Amon akoanaakamo Yosia,
Yosia akoanaakamo Yekhonya tee manga witinaina wakutuuna miana Israel atobhanaka i tana Babel,
Yekhonya akoanaakamo Sealtiel sapadhana miana Israel atobhanaka i tana Babel. Sealtiel akoanaakamo Zerubabel,
Zerubabel akoanaakamo Abihud, Abihud akoanaakamo Elyakim, Elyakim akoanaakamo Azor,
Azor akoanaakamo Zadok, Zadok akoanaakamo Akhim, Akhim akoanaakamo Eliud,
Eliud akoanaakamo Eleazar, Eleazar akoanaakamo Matan, Matan akoanaakamo Yakub,
Yakub akoanaakamo Yusuf, Yusuf sumai umanena Siti Mariam, minaaka i Siti Mariam sumai apalaahirimo Isa Al Masi. Maʼanana Al Masi "Raja ipilina Aulataʼala to apasalaamatiaka uumatina."

Jadi bhari-bharia siwuluna apepuu minaaka i Nabii Ibrahim sakawana i Raja Daud dhaangia sapulu pata siwulu, tee apepuu minaaka i Raja Daud sakawana wakutuuna miana Israel atobhanaka i tana Babel siwuluna dhaangia sapulu pata mia uka, tee mboo sumai uka minaaka i wakutuuna miana Israel atobhanaka i tana Babel sakawana Al Masi dhaangia sapulu pata mia siwuluna.
Laahiriana Isa Al Masi

Mboo siimo tulatulana laahiriana Isa Al Masi. Inana siitumo Siti Mariam, apoporae tee Yusuf. Maka indapo manga incia akawi, garaaka Siti Mariam abhawa-bhawamo. (Yusuf inda amataua ande Siti Mariam abhawa-bhawa roonamo kuasana Rohina Aulataʼala).
Yusuf poraena sii mia mobanara, jadi bheahaejatimo abhotuki Siti Mariam, maka inda amarobhoakea, mamudhaakana Siti Mariam inda amaea i aroana mia bhari.

Maka tangasaana afikiri giu incia sumai, malaaʼekatina Kawasana Opu apatiumba karona i nuncana pongipina tee apogau, "E Yusuf, anana Daud, bholi umaeka utarima Siti Mariam amembali bhawinemu roonamo o anaana ibhawa-bhawana itu minaaka i Rohina Aulataʼala Momangkilo.
Incia bheapalaahiri anaana umane tee ingkoo usarongiakea Isa,
roonamo Inciamo mopasalaamatina uumatina minaaka i dosana manga."
Bhari-bharia sumai amembali mamudhaakana apamondoa Firimanina Kawasana Opu ipakawaakana i nabiina,

content.text: "Kamatea! Samia kabuabua bheabhawa-bhawa tee apalaahiri samia Anaana umane tee manga mia bheasarongiakea Imanuel,"

content: (maʼanana, "Aulataʼala apobhawa tee ingkita.")
Sabhanguna Yusuf minaaka i koleana, incia apewaumo opea iparintangiakana malaaʼekatina Kawasana Opu. Incia atarimamea Siti Mariam to amembali bhawinena.
Moomini mboo sumai, incia sadhaadhaa inda aporomuakea sakawana Siti Mariam apalaahiri anaana sumai. Salaahirina Anaana sumai, Yusuf asarongiakamea Isa.

footnotes.text: Isa: Maʼanana Isa pogauna Ibrani, "Kawasana Opu apasalaamatiaka."
